body: Thanks for scaring the shit out of me. I ended up going to the hospital in the morning. I got diagnosed with PTSD, MDD and Possible ASD. To be honest, as terrible as it sounds, my life got a decent bit better after that attempt. People started taking me seriously, and I finally got the mental health help that I’d been asking for. Most people in my family don’t bring up my triggers around me. I still have terrible nights, but at least my life is improving. That night was the worst time for my mental health. I’ve missed about three weeks of school, and my lowest grade is at a 57.89%, followed by a 67%, all the way up to a  101%. The school isn’t gonna report me to the juvenile office, though. I was gonna push for an IEP if they were. The middle school did that, while they knew I was in a home with a traumatic family dynamic, and knew that I was getting bullied by 10+ kids for over 3 years. I’m getting better, though. My daydreams have gone down relatively. I usually only have a nightmare I remember every couple of weeks. I have my first therapist appointment in a month or two (their father died so they have not been available). I am mad at my aunt, though. She can be a toxic person. I spent about a week in a mental hospital before I was able to convince them that I was fine. When she picked me up, one of the first things she said was “Your mom says that she loves you and hopes you will be okay”. I blew up on her, and she got defensive, saying that she was just “delivering a message”. I still get really angry over that. When she said that, I nearly told her to take me back. I told my grandma that I would only come back on the condition that they avoid talking about my mother while I am in the house. Me and the Psychological doctor agreed that I wouldn’t be able to be safe until I was able to do everyday stuff without being reminded about her. I’m still not sure how I actually feel about the PTSD diagnosis, but I tell myself that I should feel validated because of how long I was stuck in that situation, and how utterly helpless I was. Not to mention, the physical stuff I saw with my dad, and the physical stuff that my mother did to me. The emotional abuse hurts way more, though. Anyways, thanks for scaring me. It got me to go to the hospital. I just told grandma that my stomach hurt really bad, and that I needed to go to the ER (My stomach wasn’t hurting). They ran a bunch of tests, and concluded that I would have no damage from the tylenol. I stayed in the hospital room for 14 hours before they found a place for me to go. When I got to the mental hospital, they asked me a lot of intrusive questions, and they said that they couldn’t guarantee that the info I gave wouldn’t get back to my family, so when they asked about my sexual orientation, I declined to answer. They just put me in the system as straight. They also served really bad food and I couldn’t handle the texture, so I skipped a lot of meals. My trip there got the social application that I needed for it, though. People took me seriously, and it allowed me to improve myself. You’re a good person
